files.description:
Imaging tests reveal clear, normal outlines of internal organs, and no abnormal shadows have been detected. Originium granules have not been detected in the circulatory system and there is no sign of infection. At this time, this operator is believed to be uninfected.

[Cell-Originium Assimilation] 0%
Umiri Yahata shows no signs of Originium infection.

[Blood Originium-Crystal Density] Undisclosed
The Medical Department has agreed not to disclose the relevant data.

Our first impression was that Ave Mujica was merely a student band that had stumbled upon Rhodes Island. Our thinking changed, however, as they blended into Rhodes, and began to ask how they could help.
We were surprised at how quickly Umiri Yahata absorbed new knowledge and put it into practice, and how she took the initiative in communication and working with others, supporting her team in the same way that the bass supports the rest of the band.
She is always calm, never flustered regardless of the situation—at least, so we thought.

'Umiri helps out our planning work here at Rhodes. She'll draft us a whole array of plans, all of them easy to understand and execute on. She's highly reliable, and we owe more than our fair share to her.'
A very fast learner, Umiri quickly earned the trust of many teams with her thorough planning and schedule management.
She is quick to grasp the mission objective and see it through without a hitch, making her the ideal partner.
'She's a serious and brisk worker, but there's always this distance between her and us...' So operators who work with her may feel on occasion, but quickly dismiss it, assuming they're just overthinking it.

It is true that Umiri has kept her distance from those around her, but it is not because she is wary of others.
She was overly eager in her first band, frequently giving instructions that she believed would help the band succeed, but ended up drawing the ire of the other band members, causing the band to fall apart.

It is easy to forget that Umiri is still a young student facing challenges appropriate to her age, so outstanding are her bass skills and management ability.
She pushes herself hard with a schedule that is packed to the brim between work and practice, as well as a rigorous training regimen.
Despite her image of perfection, Umiri can find it stressful when things do not go according to plan. Binge shopping at the Rhodes Island shop is her way of blowing off steam. While the operators there are overjoyed to see her, and take photos of her with both hands full of shopping bags as commemoration, they also remind her not to go overboard with her purchases.

[Iris's Notes]
On a subconscious level, Umiri is aware that the reason she cannot establish relations of trust with others is because she cannot bare her true heart to them.
She must overcome her past trauma and step out of her comfort zone, and once again reveal her heart to her friends.
When the day should come that Umiri wakes from the dream and forgets all that transpired within, may a part of what she experienced here remain with her and give her courage—
The courage to face others with her true heart.
